digest.en: Asia-Pacific leads the board this hour with Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका की अगुवाई है, सीरिया की राजधानी के कैफे में भीषण विस्फोट; नौ की मौत, 20 घायल; जांच में जुटीं सुरक्षा एजेंसियां मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही एशिया-प्रशांत से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition
articles.summary: Min Aung Hlaing transitioned from commander-in-chief to president in Myanmar. Five years after mounting a coup that ousted an elected civilian government, Min Aung Hlaing has overseen tightly staged elections transitioning him from commander-in-chief to president. Foreign governments should ensure interaction with Naypyitaw is calibrated, so as not to confer unwarranted legitimacy on the administration. Myanmar’s New Administration: Military Consolidation, Not Transition.

articles.title: Issues of War and Peace Gain Top Billing in Armenia’s Election
articles.summary: Armenians will hold a general election on 7 June. Armenians will head to the polls on 7 June for the country’s first general election since 2021. In this Q&A, Crisis Group expert Joshua Kucera explains why foreign policy has dominated the campaign and what the results may mean for Yerevan’s external relations. Issues of War and Peace Gain Top Billing in Armenia’s Election.

Merz argues the yuan is 30% undervalued, accuses Beijing of “flooding global markets” with artificially cheap goods and warns that its state-subsidized overcapacity is destabilizing an already fragile world economy.

articles.title: The logical case for admitting Bangladesh into ASEAN
articles.summary: Bangladesh's foreign policy under ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina focused heavily on India For decades, Bangladesh’s foreign policy operated on a predictable, singular axis. Under the sixteen-year tenure of ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, Dhaka’s strategic and economic relations were deeply tethered to New Delhi. A flurry of bilateral agreements spanning digital connectivity, transit rights, and maritime security signaled a tight, almost exclusive alignment with Indian interests.

articles.title: A baseball stadium becomes a refuge in Venezuela

articles.summary: ईरान सर्वोच्च नेता अयातुल्ला अली खामेनेई के अंतिम संस्कार की तैयारी कर रहा है। Iran Khamenei Funeral Preps Update: ईरान-अमेरिका युद्ध की शुरुआत ही ईरानी सर्वोच्च नेता अयातुल्ला अली खामेनेई की मौत के साथ हुई थी. 28 फरवरी को मारे गए खामेनेई का अंतिम संस्कार अब होने जा रहा है. उन्हें सुपुर्द-ए-खाक करने की तैयारियां चल रही हैं और ईरान ने वॉर्निंग दी है कि इजरायल ने अगर इसमें कोई गड़बड़ की तो नतीजा अच्छा नहीं होगा.
